scenes.text: The hikers were reported missing on a Sunday.
Their camera was found on a rock, still working.
The final photo showed the trail ahead - and a figure behind them.
The figure was wearing the jacket of a man still alive in the city.
He had never left his apartment.
Follow Unsolved Archive for the next file.
